Definition: from G3722; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day):--morning.
BiblicalUsage: In the early morning the women went to the tomb, and found the stone rolled away and the body gone, and they were the first to hear that He was risen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe early morning is when faith is tested: the women came while it was still dark, and found the tomb already empty.
